svg.text: PROPORTIONAL SCHEMATIC · LAYER SEPARATION NOT TO SCALE
RIGHT IS DEFAULT; PANEL CORNERS ARE SQUARE.
BODY USES THE SHARED SCROLL AREA.
FOOTER REVERSES IN A COLUMN BELOW SM.
AT SM IT IS A ROW, END-ALIGNED.
CLOSE IS OPTIONAL; HEADER RESERVES S3.
HIDDEN CLOSE RESTORES RIGHT PAD S1.
HUG AND WRAPPING HEIGHTS ARE SYMBOLIC.
FULL-BLEED SCRIM IS BELOW THE PANEL.
FOCUS TRAP, INERT PAGE, ESCAPE / OUTSIDE CLOSE.
E1 / E2 / E3 = MAXIMUM OF TWO SHADOWS.
BLUR HAS NO HARD EDGE; VIEWPORT CLIPS THE PAINT.
S4 = 16 TO TOP AND RIGHT EDGE
SCALE 3:1 · INNER PADDING IS NOT AN INSET SURFACE
SCROLLBAR OVERLAYS CONTENT; NO WIDTH RESERVED.
